_ _ _ Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput Order on Board 20.01.2023 1.

The petitioner has preferred this CRMP under Section 439(2) R/W Section 482 of CrPC for cancellation of bail order dated 06.07.2018 passed by this Court in MCRCA No.281 of 2018 in connection with Crime No.19/2018 registered at P.S. Sakri, District- Bilaspur (C.G.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 452 & 323 of IPC.
2.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that the bail was granted to respondent No.2 Sanjay Singh by this Court vide order dated 06.07.2018 in MCRCA No.281 of 2018 with certain conditions,
thereafter he violated the conditions imposed by this Court, therefore, present petition has been filed and looking to the conduct of respondent No.2, the impugned order may be set aside and present CRMP may be allowed.
3. Counsel for the State does not oppose this prayer.

4. Counsel for the respondent No.2 submits that though the anticipatory bail was granted to respondent No.2 on 06.07.2018 but he has not misused the bail granted by this Court nor he has violated any of the conditions imposed upon him.
He submits that the case itself is listed for defence evidence before the trial Court and likely to conclude the trial in short period.
